patches.title: Sequential Container Opening
patches.principle: Open containers in increasing numerical order without skipping to ensure systematic search.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for a target object and multiple closed containers exist.

patches.title: Transform Immediately After Pickup
patches.principle: After picking up an object that requires cleaning, cooling, or heating, go directly to the appropriate station and perform the transformation.
patches.when_to_apply: After picking up an object that needs transformation before placement.

patches.title: No Examine on Held Object
patches.principle: Do not examine or look at an object you are holding; instead proceed to the next required action.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs to be transformed or placed.
